FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.label: Followers Standing
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.drillDesc: Practice defensive drills with any colonist. Both stop, stand apart, and draw their weapons for the session. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.studyDesc: Make rounds with another colonist on the medical path, teaching as you go. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.inspectDesc: Review a lower-ranked guard's weapon and gear condition. Well-kept gear earns thanks, neglected gear earns a quiet word.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.punishDesc: Assign a lower-ranked guard a stretch of extra clinic shifts for a lapse in conduct, souring their mood. Once per day per colonist.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.rallyDesc: Rouse every guard among {0} on this map with a burst of speed and steady nerves, for when the wounded need protecting. Once every few days.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.fallInDesc: Call {0} to muster behind you, up to four deep, interrupting whatever they're doing. They hold until stood down.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.dismissDesc: Stand {0} down, letting them return to their duties.
